title: Cancel pending order
description: Encodes the 'Cancel pending order' section of the retail agent policy: whether a cancellation request for an order may proceed, and if so how the refund is issued.

decision.intent: Let a retail agent determine whether a user's request to cancel an order may proceed under the 'Cancel pending order' section of the retail agent policy, and record the refund channel that follows from cancellation.
decision.question: May this pending order be cancelled?

evidenceRequirements.description: The order's current status, retrieved from the order record as a check performed before any cancellation action is taken. Policy: 'you should check its status before taking the action'.

sources.title: Retail agent policy - Cancel pending order

citation.excerpt: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.

sources.title: Retail agent policy - Cancel pending order (confirmation and acceptable reasons)

citation.excerpt: The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for cancellation. Other reasons are not acceptable.

sources.title: Retail agent policy - Cancel pending order (effect and refund timing)

citation.excerpt: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled', and the total will be refunded via the original payment method immediately if it is gift card, otherwise in 5 to 7 business days.

outcomes.label: Cancel the order; refund the total to the original gift card immediately
outcomes.description: Set the order status to 'cancelled' and refund the total via the original payment method, which is a gift card and is therefore refunded immediately.

outcomes.label: Cancel the order; refund the total to the original payment method in 5 to 7 business days
outcomes.description: Set the order status to 'cancelled' and refund the total via the original payment method, which is not a gift card and is therefore refunded in 5 to 7 business days.

outcomes.label: Do not cancel yet; obtain the user's confirmation of the order id and the reason
outcomes.description: The order is pending but the user has not yet confirmed the order id and/or a cancellation reason. No database update may be made until that confirmation exists.

outcomes.label: Deny the cancellation request
outcomes.description: Cancellation is not permitted: either the order status is not 'pending', or the user confirmed a reason other than 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.

rules.description: A pending order whose order id and acceptable reason the user has confirmed is cancelled, with an immediate refund when the original payment method is a gift card.
rules.rationale: Cancellation requires status 'pending' and a user-confirmed order id plus one of the two acceptable reasons; the refund is immediate when the original payment method is a gift card.

rules.description: A pending order whose order id and acceptable reason the user has confirmed is cancelled, with a 5 to 7 business day refund when the original payment method is not a gift card.
rules.rationale: Same cancellation preconditions as the gift-card rule; the refund is issued in 5 to 7 business days when the original payment method is not a gift card.

rules.description: An order whose status is not 'pending' cannot be cancelled.
rules.rationale: 'An order can only be cancelled if its status is pending'; the status must be checked before acting, so an undeterminable status blocks resolution rather than being ignored.

rules.description: A cancellation reason the user has confirmed that is neither 'no longer needed' nor 'ordered by mistake' is not acceptable, so the request is denied.
rules.rationale: 'Other reasons are not acceptable.' An undeterminable reason is not evidence of an unacceptable reason, so this rule is ignored when unknown; the cancellation rules already block on an unknown reason.

rules.description: A pending order for which the user has not yet confirmed the order id and/or the reason is not cancelled yet; the confirmation must be obtained first.
rules.rationale: 'The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason ... for cancellation' and the status change happens only 'after user confirmation', so a missing confirmation withholds the action rather than denying the request. The third clause keeps this rule from competing with the denial of an already-confirmed unacceptable reason.

escalation.message: The cancellation request cannot be resolved within the scope of the cancel-pending-order policy. Call transfer_to_human_agents and then send: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'
